prompts.name: Portfolio Tracking Summary
prompts.template: Analyze portfolio performance for period={{period}}. Return JSON with keys: performance_snapshot, top_contributors, top_detractors, risk_signals, rebalance_ideas, next_actions. positions={{positions_json}} transactions={{transactions_json}} benchmark={{benchmark_data}}

prompts.name: Financial Statement Review
prompts.template: Review statements and return JSON with keys: trend_summary, margin_analysis, balance_sheet_health, cash_flow_quality, key_ratios, red_flags, diligence_questions. income={{income_statement_json}} balance={{balance_sheet_json}} cash={{cash_flow_json}} notes={{notes_text}}

prompts.name: Financial QA SFT Dataset Generator
prompts.template: Generate {{n}} JSONL training rows using schema: instruction, input, output, tags, difficulty, source_span. Cover revenue, margin, liquidity, solvency, cash flow, and anomaly detection. income={{income_statement_json}} balance={{balance_sheet_json}} cash={{cash_flow_json}} notes={{notes_text}}
